newsitem.title: ROMANIA: France's Chirac to visit Romania to boost ties.
newsitem.headline: France's Chirac to visit Romania to boost ties.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac will visit Bucharest on February 21-22, to express France's support to Romania's bid to join the European Union and NATO, the Romanian foreign ministry said on Tuesday.
Chirac, accompanied by senior French politicians and business leaders, will meet Romania's new centrist leaders who replaced ex-communists in elections last November.
He will hold talks with President Emil Constantinescu and Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea and will address a joint session of parliament, the ministry said.

Romania counts on traditionally good relations with France to boost its chances of joining more advanced NATO candidates -- Poland, the Czech Republic and Hungary -- when the alliance decides on its eastward expansion at a July summit in Madrid.
